limitations: Original HydroSHEDS native zone raster is reconstructed from unsimplified basin polygons with cell-center assignment.
Exact ArcGIS intermediate numeric storage/rounding is not established; preserve floating 5x5 means and compare against published integer values.
No coastal or interior void filling is inferred; partial/missing source blocks fail the completeness gate.
Pskem gauge catchment is provisional; the 20 native sub-basin identities remain explicit.
A successful comparison is not an independent scientific rerun or a released reproduction.
method: EarthEnv-DEM90 v1 -> 5x5 arithmetic mean -> native-polygon cell-center zones -> unweighted local cell mean. No spatial extrema or upstream attributes computed.
scope_note: Pskem candidate catchment IDs; gauge snapping remains unresolved. These are local native sub-basin values, not an exact gauge-catchment statistic.
